title: venture-preflight demands a launch date and catalogue section for a deployed app that has no catalogue page (payapps, jobshop-quote)
problem: Since payapps and jobshop-quote moved into ventures/ (2026-11-26/27), `node platform/pages/venture-preflight.mjs <slug>` failed on them for 'no launch date in launched.json' and 'lands in the catch-all More free tools section'. Neither has an entry index.html, so build.mjs's discoverSurfaces never lists them and the site publishes no page: both failures were meaningless, and runs had to read the script to see that.
evidence: promptctl measure, 'Doc friction by file', platform/pages/venture-preflight.mjs: 6 reports in the 3 days to 2026-11-27, including 2026-11-27T06:18 (payapps) and 07:25 (jobshop-quote)
prompts/ventures/prompt-1.md friction 2026-11-27T07:17: 'venture-preflight treats payapps ... as a free-tools catalogue entry and fails on launched.json and CATEGORY_RULES'
discoverSurfaces('ventures') on 2026-11-27 main lists neither payapps nor jobshop-quote
change: When the slug is not a discovered surface, print that it is a separately deployed app, skip the launch-date, placement and build steps, keep the repository checks and site tests (front doors such as pay-app-guides import the app's packages), and name the app's own CI (`run_workflow_locally.py <slug>-ci`) or run_venture_tests.py.
metric: venture-preflight friction reports naming launch date or placement on an unlisted venture, 14 days after merge
baseline: 6 reports in 3 days (2026-11-25 to 27); `venture-preflight.mjs payapps` exit 1 before, exit 0 after (2026-11-27)
source: process run, promptctl measure doc friction
